🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 8, 2026

Venus, in detriment in Scorpio, holds a square to Mars, in Leo. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Libra, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. Since Mars crossed out of Cancer, the question has changed.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Virgo, and what you hold finds words unforced. Fixed earth holds, and holding asks nothing back. Moon let go of it two weeks ago.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Virgo, and something has to give way. Air adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. Four weeks of Virgo ended, and nothing carried over.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Virgo, untitled. From Scorpio, Venus agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Cardinal water: beginning costs almost nothing. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you, fallen in Libra. Venus in Scorpio stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fixed fire pays to hold on. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Virgo: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. Two weeks ago Mercury was still held by Jupiter; that is finished.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Air starts and settles in the same breath. Retrograde since a week ago, Venus is still re-reading.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Venus is with you, close enough to read the small print. Fixed water: what is kept and who keeps it merge. The sextile of two weeks ago is off it now.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. From Libra, Sun offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Mutable fire: two answers, neither expensive. The hold Mercury had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Scorpio, Venus hands you an opening. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. The sextile to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. From Scorpio, Venus sets a figure against the wanting. Air holds on, and the holding is billed. After a week of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. From Scorpio, Venus concedes the point early. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. A week in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.
